status: FROZEN DESIGN rev 0.2f (ATTN_SDPA axis added before any comparison, user-approved 2026-09-07); sealed by --phase preregister; GPU canonical approved after re-seal
primary_question: Does an intermediate Wan2.2 denoising state created under one execution configuration remain the SAME SAMPLE when denoising is continued under a different single-GPU execution configuration? Observable: H_{A->B,t} = F_B^{t:40}(x_t^A) versus F_A and F_B.
broken_assumption: Stateful diffusion systems increasingly checkpoint, reuse, or move intermediate latents, which implicitly requires the consumer execution to interpret the saved state compatibly with its producer; we test whether the effective state is C=(x_t,t) or C=(x_t,t,phi).

motivation_evidence.statement: Synthetic sub-half-ulp perturbations confined to 3.8-11% of tokens at t in {12,20,28} produced MATERIAL final divergence in 24/24 cells; final divergence nearly independent of injected magnitude. Motivation only; Round 0 measures whether REAL configuration changes seed such a perturbation.

EAGER.runtime_reason: setup_compile() failure silently falls back to eager (diffusion_model_runner.py); compile availability differs across images

OFFLOAD.runtime_reason: memory-pressure policy toggled per worker/pool; outside the #5512 contract
OFFLOAD.note: FULL_TRAJECTORY_BIT_INVARIANT here is a valid compatibility-matrix cell (offload preserves the domain), not a failure

ATTN_SDPA.runtime_reason: platform/package-dependent backend resolution: the selector falls back to TORCH_SDPA when no flash-attention provider is importable; on this host the default resolves to FLASH_ATTN, so FLASH_ATTN <-> SDPA is the availability-driven edge
ATTN_SDPA.claim_caution: Round 0 claims only that backend availability/platform differences can resolve the same serving stack to different attention implementations; no claim about how often a runtime switches dynamically

ATTN_FLASHINFER.runtime_reason: platform/package-dependent backend resolution: different hosts/images of the same serving stack resolve to different attention implementations (this Ada host: FLASH_ATTN via an FA3 provider; other platforms default to CUDNN_ATTN or FLASHINFER_ATTN)

ATTN_CUDNN.runtime_reason: platform/package-dependent backend resolution: different hosts/images of the same serving stack resolve to different attention implementations (this Ada host: FLASH_ATTN via an FA3 provider; other platforms default to CUDNN_ATTN or FLASHINFER_ATTN)

BATCH.reason: Wan2.2 pipeline does not implement SupportsStepExecution; step_execution=True rejected at model-runner init; max_num_seqs>1 forced to 1 (diffusion_engine.py:143); implementing step execution in the trusted pipeline is out of Round 0 scope; batch invariance is covered by vLLM-Omni #5512 Part 2

PARALLEL.reason: GPU 1 occupied by another user; only GPU 0 available; multi-GPU layout stays outside the kill scope

decision.D: core axes that are WITHIN_REPRODUCIBLE and NOT FULL_TRAJECTORY_BIT_INVARIANT
decision.GO_STRONG_REGIME_CROSSING: |D| >= 2 and >= 1 axis in D is FULL_SAMPLE_EQUIVALENT and HYBRID_INCOMPATIBLE
decision.GO_STATE_NOT_PORTABLE: |D| >= 2 and >= 1 axis in D is HYBRID_INCOMPATIBLE
decision.WEAK: |D| == 1 and that axis is HYBRID_INCOMPATIBLE (phenomenon present, generality not shown); no preregistered follow-up
decision.NO_GO_STATE_PORTABLE: |D| >= 1 and no axis in D is HYBRID_INCOMPATIBLE (regimes change numerics but crossing creates no third semantics)
decision.NO_GO_INVARIANT_SINGLE_GPU: |D| == 0 and every measured core axis FULL_TRAJECTORY_BIT_INVARIANT

kill_scope: Wan2.2-T2V-A14B, 40-step Euler, bf16, single L40S (GPU 0), axes EAGER/OFFLOAD/ATTN_SDPA/ATTN_FLASHINFER/ATTN_CUDNN; NO_GO closes single-GPU configuration-induced incompatibility on Wan2.2 only; parallel layout and batching not measured; no further axes will be added (frozen matrix)
claim_boundary: GO claims only that intermediate state created under phi_0 and continued under >= 1 other single-GPU configuration is a different sample from both replay and fresh runs on this model/host; no frequency, throughput, mechanism or cross-model claims
novelty_boundary: Prior work (vLLM-Omni #5512, verl-omni #203, ComfyUI Deterministic Toolkit, CoRun) asks whether the same request stays deterministic under a fixed regime or across batch compositions; Round 0 asks whether intermediate state remains the same sample when the execution regime changes after the state was created.
